what: Generative Latin grooves for the FM-1: a band on the clave in twelve styles, from salsa and mambo to bolero, bossa and tango, with sampled percussion, upright piano, brass, sax, violins and double bass. Lead the band with hits and a mambo, take the trumpet solo on the keys, or play and edit each instrument on its own page.
author: delirioux
sounds: CC0: Versilian Studios' VCSL and VSCO-2 CE (hand percussion, Yamaha upright, trumpet, trombone, tenor sax, violins, double bass); kick, washboard and timbale shells synthesized by tools/ma_perc.py; drums synthesized by Felucca's tools/gen_waves.py (Hügelton Sample Pack, GPL-3.0-only)
